summary: Frontend-only end-to-end UI verification of the redesigned /pending-approvals page (Mashara Finance) with admin@finance.app. Verified page shell (premium header, 4 KPI cards, 10 tabs with counts, toolbar, cards, pagination), tab filtering, live search, Filter popover (Priority/Center/Amount/Date), active-filter badge, Clear filters, List/Grid toggle with localStorage persistence (pa_view), pagination page-prev/page-next and page reset on tab switch, priority chips derived from age, individual Approve (success toast + list count decremented, backend persisted), bulk SKIP rule for payment/advance/payroll final-step items (eligible excludes final-step, bulk-skipped-warning visible with correct count & text), bulk Approve happy-path (2 leaves -> approved, count 30 -> 28 + both cards gone), bulk Reject dialog (2 items, 0 skipped), select-all-checkbox (10 selected on current page), bulk-clear-btn hides bar, and Inbox-Zero empty state on Quotations tab. All data-testid selectors match spec. No console errors beyond the expected unauthenticated 401 on initial csrf fetch before login.

issues: Skipped-warning dialog copy mixes English + Hindi (Hinglish) e.g. 'inhe individually Approve karein (Paid By / Partner / Bank chahiye)'. Also toast when 0-eligible: 'Pehle kuch requests select karein' and 'Selected requests me payment/payroll final-step hain — inhe individually Approve karein'. Consider English-only strings for a premium SaaS UI.
Priority filter dropdown is a native <select> (not shadcn Select). Works, but visually inconsistent with rest of the shadcn-based UI inside the popover.

ux_observations: Bulk selections are tab/filter-scoped: `selectedItems = filtered.filter(selected[key])`. Selecting items on the Leaves tab then switching to Advances tab makes the earlier selection invisible to the bulk bar (counter resets to the newly-visible selected). Within the SAME filter view (e.g. All tab) both items remain selected and the skip-warning works perfectly. This is defensible (bulk operates on the current view) but may surprise users — consider either showing total selected across all tabs or clearing selection on tab change to make it explicit.

action_items: (Optional, polish) Replace Hinglish copy ('inhe individually Approve karein', 'Pehle kuch requests select karein', 'chahiye') in bulk toasts/warnings with pure English for consistency with the rest of the premium UI.
(Optional, UX) Make tab-scoped bulk selection behavior explicit: either carry selection across tabs or auto-clear selection on tab change so the counter is never misleading.
critical_code_review_comments: File size: PendingApprovals.jsx is 1249 lines — recommend splitting into subcomponents (RequestCard, BulkDialog, PayrollPayBlock, AttributionBlock, Toolbar) for maintainability (guideline: >700 lines).
Priority is correctly DERIVED client-side via priorityOf() (not a DB field) — matches spec.
needsAttribution() correctly whitelists only final-step payment/reimbursement/advance_request/payroll — matches spec.
Bulk flow partitions eligible vs skipped before confirmation — spec compliant; reject bypasses skip (eligible = selectedItems) — spec compliant.
Minor: openBulk toast when eligible=0 is informative but could instead open the dialog in a '0 eligible, N skipped' explain-mode so users understand why nothing can be bulk-approved.
